title: notocactus neo-ottoianus var. stenogonus
intro: Notocactus neo-ottoianus var. stenogonus, commonly known as Stenogon, is a cactus species native to Brazil. It is used for its medicinal properties and is known to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that can help protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Stenogon include its ability to act as a laxative and its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, such as fever and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of Stenogon include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
